description: This file contains bash functions for managing eMMC partitions and performing firmware upgrades on a device with a specific hardware configuration, likely related to the uDPU platform. It includes functions for checking device detection, preparing partitions, formatting, mounting, and performing system upgrades including firmware extraction and configuration management.

methods.name: udpu_check_emmc
methods.description: Checks available eMMC device based on board revision, sets device variable.

methods.name: udpu_part_prep
methods.description: Unmounts a given partition if mounted, preparing it for reformat or other operations.

methods.name: udpu_do_part_check
methods.description: Verifies the presence of emmc partitions; repartitions and formats if necessary.

methods.name: udpu_do_misc_prep
methods.description: Mounts or reformats the /misc partition to ensure it's ready for firmware files.

methods.name: udpu_do_initial_setup
methods.description: Formats recovery, boot, and root partitions with specific filesystems during initial setup.

methods.name: udpu_do_regular_upgrade
methods.description: Unmounts and cleans the /boot and /root partitions to prepare for firmware upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_uDPU
methods.description: Main upgrade function: checks device, prepares partitions, extracts firmware, and updates system.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_uDPU
methods.description: Copies user configuration backup from backup location to /misc during upgrade process.
